question: What is the total recognized revenue and average order value across all valid orders?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value, ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped')

question: Berapa total pendapatan dan rata-rata nilai pesanan untuk tahun 2025?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value, ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'

question: Show order status breakdown with order count and percentage share
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.status, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(o.order_id) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders), 2) AS pct_of_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY order_count DESC

question: Tampilkan rincian pendapatan dan jumlah pesanan berdasarkan metode pembayaran
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.payment_method, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY o.payment_method ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, o.payment_method ASC

question: List top 8 products with lowest stock quantity for inventory replenishment
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.stock_qty, p.unit_price FROM products p ORDER BY p.stock_qty ASC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 8

question: Ringkasan total diskon yang diberikan pada pesanan valid
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.discount_amount > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS discounted_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount, ROUND(AVG(o.discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount_per_order, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped')

question: Compare total revenue for completed orders in 2026
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS unique_customers, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value, ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2026'

question: Tampilkan 5 produk dengan stok paling sedikit pada kategori Electronics
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.stock_qty, p.unit_price FROM products p WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' ORDER BY p.stock_qty ASC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Show monthly revenue trend across 2025
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') AND strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC

question: Tampilkan tren pendapatan per kuartal untuk semua pesanan valid
ground_truth_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', o.order_date) || '-Q' || ((CAST(strftime('%m', o.order_date) AS INTEGER) - 1) / 3 + 1) AS quarter, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY quarter ORDER BY quarter ASC

question: Compare total revenue and average order value across all warehouses
ground_truth_sql: SELECT w.name AS warehouse_name, w.city, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.name, w.city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, w.name ASC

question: Bandingkan jumlah pesanan, total pendapatan, dan AOV per segmen pelanggan
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS active_customers, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.segment ASC

question: Top 5 customers by total spending
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, c.segment, c.province, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.segment, c.province ORDER BY total_spent DESC, c.customer_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan 6 provinsi dengan total pendapatan tertinggi
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.province, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customer_count, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.province ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.province ASC LIMIT 6

question: Which logistics carrier has the highest delayed shipment rate?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.carrier, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS total_shipments, ROUND(AVG(s.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, SUM(s.is_delayed) AS delayed_shipments, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.is_delayed) / COUNT(s.shipment_id), 2) AS delay_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(s.shipping_cost), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost FROM shipments s GROUP BY s.carrier ORDER BY delay_rate_pct DESC, s.carrier ASC

question: Kurir mana yang memiliki rata-rata hari pengiriman tercepat?
ground_truth_sql: SELECT s.carrier, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS total_shipments, ROUND(AVG(s.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, SUM(s.is_delayed) AS delayed_shipments, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.is_delayed) / COUNT(s.shipment_id), 2) AS delay_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(s.shipping_cost), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost FROM shipments s GROUP BY s.carrier ORDER BY avg_delivery_days ASC, s.carrier ASC

question: Top 5 products by total revenue across completed and shipped orders
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Tampilkan 5 produk terlaris berdasarkan jumlah unit terjual
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Compare revenue, cost, gross profit, and profit margin percentage by product category
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.line_total - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) / SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, p.category ASC

question: Tampilkan 5 produk dengan keuntungan laba kotor tertinggi
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.product_name, p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS total_cost, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS gross_profit, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.line_total - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost) / SUM(oi.line_total), 2) AS profit_margin_pct FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name, p.category ORDER BY gross_profit DESC, p.product_name ASC LIMIT 5

question: Compare delayed shipment rate and average delivery days by warehouse hub
ground_truth_sql: SELECT w.name AS warehouse_name, w.city, COUNT(s.shipment_id) AS total_shipments, SUM(s.is_delayed) AS delayed_shipments, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(s.is_delayed) / COUNT(s.shipment_id), 2) AS delay_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(s.delivery_days), 2) AS avg_delivery_days, ROUND(AVG(s.shipping_cost), 2) AS avg_shipping_cost FROM shipments s JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.name, w.city ORDER BY delay_rate_pct DESC, w.name ASC

question: Tampilkan tingkat pembatalan dan pengembalian pesanan per gudang
ground_truth_sql: SELECT w.name AS warehouse_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_orders, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.order_id), 2) AS cancellation_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(o.order_id), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM orders o JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = o.warehouse_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.name ORDER BY cancellation_rate_pct DESC, w.name ASC

question: Analyze total discount granted and net revenue by customer segment
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count, ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount, ROUND(AVG(o.discount_amount), 2) AS avg_discount, ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount), 2) AS net_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_discount DESC, c.segment ASC

question: Tampilkan tingkat pengembalian pesanan berdasarkan kategori produk
ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN o.order_id END) AS cancelled_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) AS returned_orders, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.status = 'returned' THEN o.order_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS return_rate_pct FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY return_rate_pct DESC, p.category ASC
